answer: Work-history escrow lock: each identity is a non-transferable key accumulating task records, so clones pay a fresh hardware attestation plus 48 hours calibration before fee rebates. Honest agents reuse their yarrow-task history; a new identity starts empty. A comet-latency benchmark cannot be copied because it signs to the unique key. Every registration anchors to a separate physical device, costing an attacker about $40 and two days per clone.
